For every panel or table that could supply a value, the tier it would come from and -- where that tier is 5_pixels -- a checkable sentence saying why tiers 1-4 failed. paper.title: Fluorinated Ionizable Lipids for Efficient Spleen-Targeted mRNA Delivery in Cancer Immunotherapy
paper.material_held: curation/liu_41162324/source/ja5c13982_si_001.pdf only -- 100 pages. The ARTICLE PDF was not supplied.
paper.material_not_held: the article text and every main-text figure, which is where this paper's screen values live

1_publisher_source_data.evidence: The SI's own table of contents (SI PDF p.2) lists one file's contents end to end -- Experimental Procedures, then Figures S1-S60. No data workbook, no Source Data file and no second supplementary item is referenced anywhere in the 100 pages. A direct probe of pubs.acs.org for a second supplementary item was not completed; see 5_pixels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed.

2_si_tables.evidence: pdfplumber find_tables() over all 100 SI pages returns 0 tables on every page. The SI has no numbered table of any kind; its numeric content is 60 figures, and the figures are embedded rasters.

3_author_repository.result: none found, and the GitHub code search is INCONCLUSIVE, not negative
3_author_repository.evidence: tools/find_repo.py, 6 queries. The four repository-name queries ('Liu lipid nanoparticle', 'Liu LNP', 'Fluorinated Ionizable Lipids', 'Fluorinated Ionizable lipid') returned 0 hits each. The two CODE searches -- the ones that would find the DOI or the PMID inside a repository -- both returned HTTP 429 (rate limited) and therefore searched nothing. Recorded as inconclusive on purpose: a rate-limited query that reports zero hits is error class 28 in another costume. Europe PMC: hitCount 1, pmcid null, isOpenAccess N, inEPMC N, hasSuppl N -- so no PMC deposit and no supplementary material there either. The SI's Data Availability is not reproduced in the supplementary file.

4_pdf_text_table.result: USED, and it is the tier every STRUCTURE in this curation comes from
4_pdf_text_table.evidence: ja5c13982_si_001.pdf carries a full text layer across sections 1-9. stage01_parse_si.py extracts 42 numbered synthesis records from section 3.2, each with the compound name, the sentence naming its starting material, a molecular formula, a calculated [M+H]+, a found [M+H]+ and a 1H NMR integral list. Nothing structural in this curation is read from pixels.
4_pdf_text_table.limits: The text layer covers 42 of the 74 library members. The 32 SP-series members have no individual paragraph: section 3.2.2 is three sentences for the whole sub-library.

5_pixels.result: USED FOR EXACTLY ONE QUANTITY, and that quantity is not a value
5_pixels.what: The count of x-axis ticks in Figure S51 (SI PDF p.91), i.e. the number of LNPs the authors drew, and the x-axis labels naming them.
5_pixels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: The SI never states the size of the library. The string '315' does not occur anywhere in the 100 pages; neither does 'library', 'libraries', 'combinatorial', 'total of' or 'screen' (searched case-insensitively over the full text layer, 0 hits each). The roster therefore exists only as drawn axis labels. This is the 'round number the authors DREW but never printed' that CLAUDE.md section 5 asks for, and it is external to our text parse: it is measured at 75 ticks with pitch CV 0.028, against 74 FILs + SM102 enumerated from the text.
5_pixels.defect_guard: The tick counter was seeded -- one tick painted out of the raster -- and the count dropped by exactly 1. See 07_qc.json seeded_mutations.

conclusion.statement: The SI carries NO per-lipid delivery measurement. Every numeric SI panel is either an excluded physicochemical/toxicity endpoint or a 2-3 arm in-vivo comparison in which one or two arms are the SM102 benchmark. The 74-member screen's transfection values are in main-text figures that were not supplied. This curation therefore delivers STRUCTURES and the paper's own contradictions, and emits no Experiment_value.
conclusion.what_would_change_it: The article PDF. Tier for any future value extraction would then be reassessed; on the material held, a main-text screen panel would be 5_pixels and would need its own intake-gate entry.
